tractor.title: Tractor & Equipment Expense Tracker
tractor.subtitle: Track daily tractor and machinery expenses crop-wise with automated day totals and lifecycle management.
tractor.no_crops_desc: Please sow or register a crop first to start tracking tractor and equipment expenses.
tractor.form_subtitle: Enter daily hours and rate to automatically log expense under this crop.
tractor.field_equipment_placeholder: e.g. Mahindra 575 DI, John Deere, Rotavator
tractor.field_notes_placeholder: e.g. Deep ploughing before monsoon sowing
tractor.no_entries: No tractor or equipment expenses recorded for this crop yet.
tractor.add_first_prompt: Click 'Add Tractor Entry' above to log your first equipment operation.
tractor.delete_entry_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this tractor entry?
tractor.crop_danger_desc: Once this crop is harvested and completed, you can review all expenses and delete the crop. Deleting will permanently remove all associated tractor & equipment records.
tractor.delete_crop_warning: Warning: This action cannot be undone! When you delete this crop, all tractor & equipment expense records, logs, and financial records tied to this crop will be permanently purged from the database.

disease.title: Crop Disease Detection & Plant Health
disease.subtitle: Capture or upload a leaf photo to diagnose crop diseases and receive expert multi-treatment recommendations.
disease.disclaimer_text: AI detection is an advisory recommendation based on leaf image patterns. Serious, uncertain, or widespread crop infections should be verified in person with a qualified agricultural officer or local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) scientist before chemical treatment application.
disease.add_expense_modal_subtitle: Store your fertilizer or chemical purchase directly under this crop's financial investment dashboard.
disease.expense_success: Expense successfully recorded under crop investment!
disease.history_subtitle: Review previous diagnoses, leaf photos, recommendations, and logged treatment expenses for this crop.
disease.no_history: No disease history recorded for this crop yet.
disease.camera_error: Unable to access device camera. Please check camera permissions or use Upload Photo.
disease.drop_photo: Drag and drop leaf photo here, or click to browse
disease.supports_formats: Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP files up to 10MB
disease.delete_history_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this disease history record?
